# License supplements

`rmcp-LICENSE` is the root license of `modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk` at
[`79437f291b2c44053d00dcd5db969fd0cca7c887`](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk/blob/79437f291b2c44053d00dcd5db969fd0cca7c887/LICENSE),
the source revision recorded in `.cargo_vcs_info.json` for both published
`rmcp` and `rmcp-macros` 3.5.1 crates. Their crate archives omit license files.
The supplement preserves the Apache/MIT transition explanation, both license
texts, the original MIT attribution, and the separate documentation terms.

The copied content has SHA-256
`0382b0057770ca05e9c350a50aa3b1c1fea84da0bc81d723bf00b9aa841be58a`.
`scripts/release_notices.py` checks the crate versions, source revision, and
supplement hash before using it. Recheck upstream notices and licensing before
changing those pins. The root project license does not replace this supplement.
